comparison.objective: Diagnose and repair a fixture that admits a backward part, then verify correct and incorrect orientations.
comparison.physical_skill: Pin removal, guide exchange, part-number selection, precise seating, and multi-case functional verification.
comparison.success_condition: Fault demonstrated; correct spare installed and pinned; aligned part seats; reversed part is blocked 11–13 mm high; fixture left restored.
comparison.reason: Both include maintenance and functional verification, but this tests keyed part discrimination and guide replacement. It does not test fine torque-tool use or iterative tuning from measured impact behavior.
